image_description: A highly ornate, gilded Baroque-style altarpiece (reredos) situated within a church sanctuary. The structure features a central niche with a red backdrop and a cross at the apex, flanked by twisted Solomonic columns and elaborate gold leaf carvings. In the foreground, a rectangular altar table is covered with a white cloth featuring subtle patterns. The background shows a dark arched alcove.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the fine details of the gilded reredos. AI generators often struggle with the intricate, repetitive patterns of Baroque carvings, leading to 'mushy' details or asymmetrical errors that look correct at a glance but fail under scrutiny. Verify if the cross at the top is structurally sound and properly connected. Check the drape of the white cloth for physical plausibility (gravity/folds).
